method: Every result is integer arithmetic on whole tenths of an inch. The chosen length is converted to tenths (12 in per foot, 39.37007874015748 in per metre) and split by the butt, taper and tippet shares: each share is floored and the leftover tenths go to the largest fractional parts in section order, so the three printed lengths always add back to the rounded total. Diameters treat the conventional X scale as a definition (0X = 0.011 in, 0.001 in less per size) and report millimetres from the same thousandths, so 4X is 0.007 in and 0.178 mm. The taper step count is the butt diameter minus the tippet diameter in thousandths. Extension mode subtracts the existing leader from the target, requires at least 6 in (15 cm) of new tippet, and reports the tippet share of the finished length and the existing-to-tippet ratio. Lengths are limited to 3-30 ft or 1-9 m, butt diameters to 0.015-0.030 in, tippet sizes to 0X-8X, and custom shares to whole percentages from 1 to 98 that add up to 100. Everything runs locally in the browser with no storage, uploads or network requests.
